home.title: Surgical robots. Smarter devices. New possibilities.
home.description: Explore surgical robotics, medical devices, imaging, and clinical AI with Baltimore’s clinicians, engineers, researchers, and founders.
home.intro: From surgical robots to wearable sensors, Baltimore MedTech connects the people building medical technology with the people who use it. Bring your prototype, your research, or a problem worth solving.

topics.title: Surgical robotics
topics.label: Precision meets engineering
topics.description: Robot-assisted surgery, surgical navigation, simulation, and the instruments that connect engineering to the operating room.

topics.title: Medical devices & wearables
topics.label: Hardware with a human purpose
topics.description: Connected sensors, prosthetics, rehabilitation tools, and devices shaped by everyday clinical needs.

topics.title: Imaging & diagnostics
topics.label: See more. Ask better questions.
topics.description: Medical imaging, point-of-care diagnostics, biosensors, and new ways to turn measurements into useful information.

topics.title: Clinical AI & software
topics.label: Build with the care team
topics.description: Decision support, workflow tools, and clinical data systems—with room to discuss evidence, usability, and real-world evaluation.

home.title: Better care starts with a better-connected city.
